database_summary: Small bowling/tournament schema with participant (Bowlers), teams, tournaments, matches and per-bowler per-game scores. Mix of current and archive tables (many archives empty). Natural grains: Bowlers (one row per bowler), Teams (one per team), Tournaments (one per tournament), Tourney_Matches (one per tournament match), Match_Games (one per game within a match), Bowler_Scores (one per bowler per match game). Numeric measures exist for scores and aggregated bowler totals/averages. Joins on MatchID/GameNumber and TeamID/TourneyID are the primary relationships; caution: joining Bowler_Scores to Match_Games or Tourney_Matches can multiply rows if not grouped because there are multiple games per match and multiple bowlers per match.

accepted.name: bowler_scores_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  MatchID,
  GameNumber,
  BowlerID,
  RawScore,
  HandiCapScore,
  WonGame
FROM
  Bowler_Scores
accepted.description: Normalized/cleaned per-bowler-per-game scores. Use this as the canonical per-game score row for aggregations and joins; preserves original keys and exposes score measures and game outcome flag. | Use for: Per-bowler per-game scoring queries; Aggregations of RawScore/HandiCapScore by bowler, match, or game; Identifying winners of individual games by bowler

accepted.name: bowlers_dim
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  BowlerID,
  BowlerLastName,
  BowlerFirstName,
  BowlerMiddleInit,
  BowlerAddress,
  BowlerCity,
  BowlerState,
  BowlerZip,
  BowlerPhoneNumber,
  TeamID,
  BowlerTotalPins,
  BowlerGamesBowled,
  BowlerCurrentAverage,
  BowlerCurrentHcp
FROM
  Bowlers
accepted.description: Canonical Bowler (player) dimension containing identifying and contact attributes and maintained aggregates. Use for lookups and joins to add names, team membership, and current aggregate stats. | Use for: Player lookups by ID or name; Joining player attributes to score or match-level data; Listing bowlers by team or location

accepted.name: match_games_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  MatchID,
  GameNumber,
  WinningTeamID
FROM
  Match_Games
accepted.description: Per-match-game rows with winning team. Use to join game-level outcomes to per-bowler scores or match metadata. | Use for: Determine which team won each game; Join game winners to bowler scores to compute team-level performance

accepted.name: tourney_matches_core
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  MatchID,
  TourneyID,
  Lanes,
  OddLaneTeamID,
  EvenLaneTeamID
FROM
  Tourney_Matches
accepted.description: Tournament match-level metadata: which tournament a match belongs to and lane/team assignments. Use to connect matches to tournaments and teams. | Use for: Relate matches to tournaments; List matches and lane/team pairings for a tournament

accepted.name: tournaments_dim
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  TourneyID,
  TourneyDate,
  TourneyLocation
FROM
  Tournaments
accepted.description: Tournament dimension table with date and location. Use to filter or group results by tournament attributes. | Use for: Filter performances by tournament date or location; Aggregate results across tournaments or by date ranges

accepted.name: bowler_game_summary
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  MatchID,
  BowlerID,
  COUNT(*) AS GamesPlayed,
  SUM(RawScore) AS TotalRawScore,
  AVG(RawScore) AS AvgRawScore,
  SUM(HandiCapScore) AS TotalHandiCapScore,
  AVG(HandiCapScore) AS AvgHandiCapScore,
  SUM(CASE WHEN WonGame=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS GamesWon
FROM
  Bowler_Scores
GROUP BY
  MatchID,
  BowlerID
accepted.description: Aggregated measures per bowler per match: sums and averages across all games for the same MatchID and BowlerID. Useful to evaluate a bowler's match-level performance. | Use for: Compare bowlers within a match; Compute match MVPs or identify bowlers with most wins in a match

accepted.name: bowler_overall_career
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.BowlerID,
  b.BowlerLastName,
  b.BowlerFirstName,
  b.TeamID,
  b.BowlerTotalPins,
  b.BowlerGamesBowled,
  b.BowlerCurrentAverage,
  b.BowlerCurrentHcp,
  CASE WHEN b.BowlerGamesBowled IS NOT NULL AND b.BowlerGamesBowled>0 THEN (1.0*b.BowlerTotalPins)/b.BowlerGamesBowled ELSE NULL END AS CareerPinsPerGame
FROM
  Bowlers b
accepted.description: Career-level aggregated statistics per bowler using maintained totals from Bowlers plus computed rates where possible. Useful for ranking bowlers or joining career stats to tournament-level results. | Use for: Rank bowlers by career rate or totals; Join career stats to tournament performances

accepted.name: team_roster
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  br.BowlerID,
  br.BowlerLastName,
  br.BowlerFirstName,
  br.TeamID,
  t.TeamName,
  t.CaptainID,
  br.BowlerTotalPins,
  br.BowlerGamesBowled,
  br.BowlerCurrentAverage,
  br.BowlerCurrentHcp
FROM
  Bowlers br
LEFT JOIN
  Teams t
ON
  br.TeamID = t.TeamID
accepted.description: Denormalized roster: bowlers with their team attributes. Use to join team names to bowlers and to compute team-level aggregates when combined with scores. | Use for: Team-level aggregations; Listing roster with contact and aggregate stats; Identify team captains and team membership

accepted.name: game_scores_with_players_and_teams
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  bs.MatchID,
  bs.GameNumber,
  bs.BowlerID,
  b.BowlerLastName,
  b.BowlerFirstName,
  b.TeamID,
  t.TeamName,
  bs.RawScore,
  bs.HandiCapScore,
  bs.WonGame,
  mg.WinningTeamID
FROM
  Bowler_Scores bs
LEFT JOIN
  Bowlers b
ON
  bs.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
LEFT JOIN
  Teams t
ON
  b.TeamID = t.TeamID
LEFT JOIN
  Match_Games mg
ON
  bs.MatchID = mg.MatchID
  AND bs.GameNumber = mg.GameNumber
accepted.description: Per-game score rows enriched with bowler name, team and game winner team. Useful for queries that need to compare individual performance vs. game outcome or to compute team totals per game. | Use for: Compare individual performance to game result; Compute team totals per game and identify which bowlers won their games; List detailed per-game scorecards

accepted.name: match_team_game_totals
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  bs.MatchID,
  bs.GameNumber,
  COALESCE(b.TeamID, NULL) AS TeamID,
  SUM(bs.RawScore) AS TeamTotalRawScore,
  SUM(bs.HandiCapScore) AS TeamTotalHandiCapScore
FROM
  Bowler_Scores bs
LEFT JOIN
  Bowlers b
ON
  bs.BowlerID = b.BowlerID
GROUP BY
  bs.MatchID,
  bs.GameNumber,
  b.TeamID
accepted.description: Aggregated team-level totals per match game (sums of RawScore/HandiCapScore). Useful to determine team scores by game and to compare against WinningTeamID from Match_Games. | Use for: Determine per-game team totals; Compare team totals to recorded WinningTeamID; Rank teams within a match by game score

accepted.name: bowler_match_rank_within_match
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  bms.MatchID,
  bms.BowlerID,
  bms.TotalRawScore,
  bms.AvgRawScore,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY bms.MatchID ORDER BY bms.TotalRawScore DESC) AS MatchRankByTotalRawScore
FROM
  (SELECT
     MatchID,
     BowlerID,
     SUM(RawScore) AS TotalRawScore,
     AVG(RawScore) AS AvgRawScore
   FROM
     Bowler_Scores
   GROUP BY
     MatchID,
     BowlerID) bms
accepted.description: Rank bowlers within each MatchID by TotalRawScore (descending). Exposes rank so callers can filter top-N per match. Use for selecting match-level top performers without baking a fixed N. | Use for: Select top-N bowlers per match; Identify match MVPs or rank performance within a match

accepted.name: bowler_running_totals_by_match
accepted.body_sql:
SELECT
  bs.MatchID,
  bs.BowlerID,
  bs.GameNumber,
  bs.RawScore,
  SUM(bs.RawScore) OVER (PARTITION BY bs.MatchID, bs.BowlerID ORDER BY bs.GameNumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS RunningTotalRawScore
FROM
  Bowler_Scores bs
accepted.description: Per-bowler running totals of RawScore across GameNumber within a MatchID (ordered by GameNumber). Use to compute progression across games within a match or to derive come-from-behind patterns. | Use for: Show score progression for a bowler within a match; Compute lead changes or cumulative performance across games
